theorem cstep_sound (C : CState) (o : COp) : CRel k C o (cstep k C o) := by
  cases o with
  | newArena st i => exact liftR_guarded
  | newPool st i => exact liftR_guarded
  | newStack st i => exact liftR_guarded
  | allocSlot j d => exact liftR_liftO (allocSlotOut_sound _ _ _)
  | resolve j h m => exact liftR_liftO (resolveOut_sound _ _ _ _)
  | resolveMany j hs m => exact liftR_liftO (resolveManyOut_sound _ _ _ _)
  | unresolve c => exact liftR_liftO (unresolveOut_sound _ _)
  | freeSlot j h => exact liftR_liftO (freeSlotOut_sound _ _ _)
  | push j n d => exact liftR_liftO (pushOut_sound _ _ _ _)
  | mark j => exact liftR_liftO (markOut_sound _ _)
  | rewind j m => exact liftR_liftO (rewindOut_sound _ _ _)
  | grow j b e => exact liftR_liftO (growOut_sound _ _ _ _)
  | _ => exact liftR_liftO (lstep_sound _ _)

/-- A computed `reject` is a `reject` outcome of the relation (§58). -/
theorem crejects {C : CState} {o : COp} (h : verdictOf (cstep k C o) = .reject) :
    CRel k C o .reject := by
  have hs := cstep_sound (k := k) C o
  revert hs h
  cases cstep k C o with
  | ok => intro h; cases h
  | reject => intro _ hs; exact hs
  | fail => intro h; cases h

/-- A computed `fail` is a `fail` outcome of the relation (§58). -/
theorem cfails {C : CState} {o : COp} (h : verdictOf (cstep k C o) = .fail) :
    CRel k C o .fail := by
  have hs := cstep_sound (k := k) C o
  revert hs h
  cases cstep k C o with
  | ok => intro h; cases h
  | reject => intro h; cases h
  | fail => intro _ hs; exact hs

/-- A computed `ok` is the `ok` outcome of the relation to `cnext k C o` (§58). -/
theorem coks {C : CState} {o : COp} (h : verdictOf (cstep k C o) = .ok) :
    CRel k C o (.ok (cnext k C o)) := by
  have hs := cstep_sound (k := k) C o
  unfold cnext
  revert hs h
  cases cstep k C o with
  | ok => intro _ hs; exact hs
  | reject => intro h; cases h
  | fail => intro h; cases h

end Sound

/-! ## Kernel side of library steps (§57; Part XIV; HandlePool v0.5, HP5-7; DS-v2) -/

/-- The kernel part of an arena library step is a sequence of kernel steps (Part XIV, §57:
`newArena` changes no kernel component, `issue` is `split` then `store`, `reset` is `derive` then
`release`). -/
theorem LStep.kseq {k : K} {L L' : LState} (h : LStep k L L') :
    HandlePool.KSeq k L.kern L'.kern := by
  cases h with
  | kernel hk => exact .single hk
  | newArena hs => rw [newArena_kernel hs]; exact .refl _
  | issue hs =>
instance (s : S3) (m : Mode) (q : Nat) : Decidable (HasRight s m q) := by
  unfold HasRight; infer_instance

/-- Authority `g` grounds the right `HasRight(s, m, q)` (§43; §63.4, §69.2, §70.3: "the
exercisable authority on which that right rests"): it is exercisable at `m` and its effective mode
permits `m` on every leaf of `q`'s footprint. -/
def Grounds (s : S3) (m : Mode) (q g : Nat) : Prop :=
  g ∈ List.range s.A.length ∧ s.ExercisableAt g m ∧
    ∀ l ∈ footprint s.P q, Allows (effective s g l) m

/-- Decidability of `Grounds` (§63.4, §69.2, §70.3). -/
instance (s : S3) (m : Mode) (q g : Nat) : Decidable (Grounds s m q g) := by
  unfold Grounds; infer_instance

/-- Authority `j` is the grounding authority `g` or belongs to its origin chain (§63.4, §69.2,
§70.3: "the exercisable authority on which that right rests and its origin chain"). -/
def RightChain (s : S3) (g j : Nat) : Prop := j = g ∨ j ∈ s.ancs g

/-- Decidability of `RightChain` (§63.4, §69.2, §70.3). -/
instance (s : S3) (g j : Nat) : Decidable (RightChain s g j) := by
  unfold RightChain; infer_instance

library-reachable and that its kernel state is reached by kernel steps and ends of slot contents.

state (`ResolveStep`, `FreeSlotStep`, `NewPoolStep`, `NewArenaStep`, `NewStackStep`, `StoreStep`,
`TransferStep`, …) and decided by `decide`. Each docstring gives the expected verdict from the
case's source, the obtained verdict, the class (material §0, rule 5: `Lib` library instance) and
the positive twin of each rejection or `fail` (rule 2: the same sequence without the faulty
element, accepted). A case whose obtained verdict differs from the expected one keeps its expected
verdict and is marked **MISMATCH** with its cause.

28	`NewArenaStep`, `NewStackStep`, `StoreStep`, `TransferStep`, …) and decided by `decide`. Each
29	docstring gives the expected verdict from the case's source, the obtained verdict, the class
30	(material §0, rule 5: `Lib` library instance) and the positive twin of each rejection or `fail`
31	(rule 2: the same sequence without the faulty element, accepted). Where spec v0.1, HandlePool v0.5
32	or DS-v2 changes the verdict the source gave, the docstring records the historical expected
33	verdict, its justification, the new expected verdict and the clause or contract item that decides
34	it (arbitration Q21). A case whose obtained verdict differs from the expected one keeps its
35	expected verdict and is marked **MISMATCH** with its cause.

55	Local shapes are lists of (parent, kind) (§71.1, §72); `lf` is a root leaf, `pt p` a part of
56	place `p`. Places and authorities are list indices (§38): `enterFrame` appends the locals and one
57	root authority per local; `alloc` appends the shape and one root authority; `derive` and `split`

59	authority; `resolve` appends a companion and an entry authority; `resolveMany` a companion and one
60	entry authority per handle. Pools and stacks are named by their registry index; a handle is
61	`⟨pool identity, slot index, generation⟩`.
